summary: Skill/prompt改善はwith/withoutまたはold/candidateを同一条件で比較し、holdout（validation）caseを候補生成側に見せず、受け入れはvalidation側の改善で判定、独立reviewer/blind A/Bを併用し、1 iteration 1変更でrejected editも記録する。評価は能力探索suiteと安定regression suiteに分ける。

evidence.summary: agentskills.io Evaluating: with_skill/without_skill（またはold_skill）比較、assertionは観察後に追加、常にpass/failするassertionは除去、blind comparison、「Keep the skill lean... If pass rates plateau despite adding more rules, the skill may be over-constrained—try removing instructions」。
train/validation split（60/40）、validation結果を改善過程から隔離、best iterationはvalidation pass rateで選ぶ（最後のiterationとは限らない）、確定後に新規5–10 queryで確認。
skill-creator: 「Rather than put in fiddly overfitty changes ... try branching out and using different metaphors」「Remove things that aren't pulling their weight」、blind A/B mode。
SkillOpt (Microsoft): 別optimizerがscored traceを有界add/delete/replace編集に変換し、validation scoreが厳密に改善した時だけ採用、rejected-edit buffer。6 benchmark×7 modelで52組全てで最良/同率、GPT-5.5で+19.1〜+24.8pt。
FAPO: evaluate→attribute→propose→validate variantsの反復、GEPA比15/18で優位、+14.1pp平均。holdout明示なし（引用時注意）。
vendor optimize-skill eval-design: holdoutは全体の20%以上、候補生成agentにholdoutのexpected answerを見せない、templateの値違いはholdoutにならない、subjective caseはblind A/B。
Anthropic: capability evalとregression evalを分け、living artifactとしてowner保守。

optimize-skill (org-private, reputation unknown): pass 1 read the plugin's references: eval-design.md defines the holdout share and forbids the candidate-authoring agent from seeing holdout expected answers; operational-guardrails.md requires blind A/B and an independent reviewer; optimization-method.md enforces one scoped change per iteration with rejected variants recorded; promotion-policy.md gates on validation-side improvement.

applies_when: Skill/prompt/descriptionを反復改善する（手動・自動を問わず）
改善効果を数値で主張する場合
not_applicable_when: 評価caseが5件未満でsplit不能（その場合はまずcase追加）

expected_effect.primary: 特定eval caseへの過適合の検出と防止、改善主張の信頼性向上
metrics: train vs validation pass rateの乖離

risks: LLM judgeのbias（blindでも同model judgeは限界）
holdout自体がoracle decayする（定期監査要）
cost: case設計・splitに数時間、iterationごとの複数run cost
known_failure_modes: 全caseで最適化して最良iterationを選ぶ
常にpassするassertionを残しpass rateを水増し
optimizerが自分の変更を自己承認する（SkillOpt/FAPOはいずれも独立validation gate）

existing_asset.confirmed_by: pass 1 read the plugin's references: eval-design.md defines the holdout share and forbids the candidate-authoring agent from seeing holdout expected answers; operational-guardrails.md requires blind A/B and an independent reviewer; optimization-method.md enforces one scoped change per iteration with rejected variants recorded; promotion-policy.md gates on validation-side improvement.
matched_on: holdout kept hidden from the candidate-authoring agent, at least 20% of cases
blind A/B plus an independent reviewer for subjective cases
one scoped change per iteration with rejected variants recorded

evidence: org-private shared plugin in the TechLog shared checkout; not published

existing_asset.verified_by: existing-skill research 2026-08-15 (ai-development-improvement 0.7.1 lookup + reputation pass, Opus workers)

alternates.why_not_primary: The established public implementation of the holdout and blind-comparison core (60/40 train/validation, 'never let the optimization process see validation results', best iteration selected by test score, blind judging by an independent agent) and the asset to name to readers; it lacks the one-change-per-iteration discipline, the rejected-edit record and the capability/regression split, so the org-private Skill remains the fuller mechanism match.
